pkgmetadata.longdescription: Out-of-tree force-feedback driver for Thrustmaster racing wheels, including the T300RS and T248, with experimental support for other models. Includes the hid-tminit and usb-tminit initialization modules. Kernel modules are built and installed using Gentoo's linux-mod-r1 eclass rather than DKMS. Modules are installed in the kernel's updates directory. When migrating from a manual installation, enable modules-compress if the existing modules follow the kernel's compression setting, or remove stale copies with a different compression format before loading the new driver. The 9999 live ebuild tracks the upstream default branch and uses the hid-tminit submodule revision recorded by that branch.
